name: Astor Basa Jehichant
source:
NOBLE ROMANCE

The sword and shield of the kingdom. Elegant, distant, and unreadable to all. Yet before Chris, his composure falters―revealing a side no one else can see.

[From [url=https://how-to-grow-a-man.fandom.com/wiki/Astor_Basa_Jehichant]How to Grow a Man Wiki[/url]]
